implementerProof.how: I re-ran every command of the implementer's at 790a7969 on Bun 1.4.4, after `bun install --frozen-lockfile` (no changes; both patch hunks present). envoy-client nats-stall: 3 pass (A 30.0 s, B 50.0 s with the hung redial closed 20.0 s after the accept, C 30.2 s). claude-envoy stall: 2 pass ('resubscribed 29.9 s, missed message shown 29.9 s'; 'SIGTERM -> exited after 0.0 s'). check-dist: 'dist/ and legion/ match a fresh build'. pi-envoy -t 'NATS path freezes': 1 pass (30.0 s). Go listener and session tests: ok 18.3 s and 6.2 s. Correction to its proof: the row C negative control it records for 790a7969 ('reconnect none … [60261.41ms]') carries the same timing as its round-3 record and does not reproduce on this head's Bun. With the protocol.js hunk reverted, row C at 4 MiB PASSED on Bun 1.4.4 ('reconnect 30.0 s, first publish received 30.1 s'). I fixed the test (commit a5a67218, below). The implementer's observed results stand.

testChanges.what: packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/nats-stall.test.ts row C: unackedBytes 4 MiB → 32 MiB, with a comment saying why; the envoy-client CHANGELOG line that names the size, updated to match.
testChanges.why: On Bun 1.4.4, the version this repository pins and CI runs, a 4 MiB backlog behind the frozen path still drains into the kernel, so nats.js's stale-close flush completes and the client redials even without the patch. Row C then guarded nothing. Measured with the protocol.js hunk reverted (throwaway script on a real natsd and listener): Bun 1.3.14 hangs at 4 and 16 MiB; Bun 1.4.4 recovers at 4 MiB (30.1 s) and hangs at 8, 16 and 32 MiB (never). The implementer's README says Bun silently ignores a patchedDependencies entry for a nats version that is not installed, so a nats bump would drop the patch with nothing failing. Row C is the lock against that.
testChanges.evidence: On Bun 1.4.4 at a5a67218: `cd packages/envoy-client && LEGION_E2E_ENVOY_STACK=1 bun test src/__tests__/nats-stall.test.ts` → 3 pass (A 30.0 s, B 50.0 s with the hung redial closed after 20.0 s, C 30.1 s). With the protocol.js hunk reverted for one run, row C: 'reconnect none, first publish received never after the freeze', (fail) [60077.74ms]. The patched file was restored afterwards.

proof.observed: At a5a67218: 3 pass (A 30.0 s; B 50.0 s, hung redial closed 20.0 s after the accept; C with 32 MiB unacknowledged 30.1 s). The patched nats on Bun 1.4.4 recovers at 16 and 32 MiB in 30.1 s.
